mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer (id, data_set_id, source_file_id, layer_key, layer_name, group_id, original_group_id, geometry_type, assignment_mode, enabled, style_mode) VALUES (#{l.id}, #{l.dataSetId}, #{l.sourceFileId}, #{l.layerKey}, #{l.layerName}, #{l.groupId}, #{l.originalGroupId}, #{l.geometryType}, #{l.assignmentMode}, #{l.enabled}, #{l.styleMode})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer WHERE source_file_id = #{fileId} AND layer_status = 'IMPORTING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l WHERE l.source_file_id = #{fileId} AND l.deleted = 0 ORDER BY l.id
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer SET layer_status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id = l.data_set_id AND ds.deleted = 0 WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0 AND l.layer_status = 'READY'
SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id = l.data_set_id AND ds.deleted = 0 WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0 AND l.layer_status = 'READY' FOR UPDATE OF l
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l SET feature_count = s.total, geographic_extent = CASE WHEN s.total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ST_SetSRID(s.bounds::geometry,4326) END, geometry_types = COALESCE(s.types, '[]'::jsonb), data_version = l.data_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM (SELECT count(*) AS total, ST_Extent(geom) AS bounds, jsonb_agg(DISTINCT GeometryType(geom) ORDER BY GeometryType(geom)) AS types FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature WHERE layer_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0) s WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0
UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer SET deleted = 1, source_file_id = NULL, data_version = data_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature (id, layer_id, geom, properties, source_feature_id, source_feature_index, source_geometry_path, classification_rule_key) VALUES
(#{f.id}, #{f.layerId}, ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{f.geometryJson}), CAST(#{f.propertiesJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{f.sourceFeatureId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{f.sourceFeatureIndex,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{f.sourceGeometryPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{f.classificationRuleKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature f WHERE f.layer_id = #{layerId} AND f.id = #{id} AND f.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature SET geom = ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{f.geometryJson}), properties = CAST(#{f.propertiesJson} AS jsonb), version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE layer_id = #{f.layerId} AND id = #{f.id} AND version = #{expected} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature SET deleted = 1, version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE layer_id = #{layerId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{expected} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer WHERE source_file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT count(*) FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer WHERE data_set_id = #{dataSetId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, layer_id, name, is_default, version, create_time, update_time FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_style WHERE layer_id = #{layerId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, id
SELECT id, layer_id, name, is_default, definition::text AS definition_json, version, create_time, update_time FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_style WHERE layer_id = #{layerId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT id, layer_id, name, is_default, definition::text AS definition_json, version, create_time, update_time FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_style WHERE layer_id = #{layerId} AND is_default
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_style(id, layer_id, name, is_default, definition) VALUES(#{s.id}, #{s.layerId}, #{s.name}, #{s.isDefault}, CAST(#{s.definitionJson} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_style SET is_default = false, version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE layer_id = #{layerId} AND is_default
UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_style SET is_default = true, version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND layer_id = #{layerId} AND version = #{expected}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_style WHERE id = #{id} AND layer_id = #{layerId} AND version = #{expected} AND NOT is_default
mapper.select: SELECT set_config('statement_timeout', CAST(#{milliseconds} AS text), true) || set_config('jit','off',true) || set_config('plan_cache_mode','force_custom_plan',true)

SELECT s.data_set_id,s.schema_version,s.data_revision,s.template_checksum FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_dataset_style s JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id=s.data_set_id AND ds.deleted=0 AND ds.category_id=2 WHERE s.data_set_id=#{dataSetId}
SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_dataset_style s JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id=s.data_set_id AND ds.deleted=0 AND ds.category_id=2 WHERE s.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} FOR UPDATE OF s
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_dataset_style(id,data_set_id,template_id,template_version,schema_version,definition,cartography,template_checksum) VALUES(#{s.id},#{s.dataSetId},#{s.templateId},#{s.templateVersion},#{s.schemaVersion},CAST(#{s.definitionJson} AS jsonb),CAST(#{s.cartographyJson} AS jsonb),#{s.templateChecksum})
mapper.select: SELECT g.*,count(l.id) AS layer_count,COALESCE(sum(l.feature_count),0)::bigint AS feature_count FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_group g LEFT JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l ON l.group_id=g.id AND l.data_set_id=g.data_set_id AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' WHERE g.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} GROUP BY g.id ORDER BY g.sort_order,g.id
SELECT * FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_group WHERE data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_dataset_style SET data_revision=data_revision+CASE WHEN #{data} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, display_revision=display_revision+CASE WHEN #{display} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, style_version=style_version+CASE WHEN #{display} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE data_set_id=#{dataSetId}

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer SET group_id=#{l.groupId},assignment_mode=#{l.assignmentMode}, enabled=#{l.enabled},style_mode=#{l.styleMode},presentation_version=presentation_version+1, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{l.id} AND presentation_version=#{expected} AND deleted=0 AND layer_status='READY'
mapper.select: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_SetSRID(ST_Extent(geographic_extent)::geometry,4326)) FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer WHERE data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND deleted=0 AND layer_status='READY'

SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(g.group_key,s.definition),'{}'::jsonb)::text FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_style s JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_group g ON s.group_id=g.id WHERE g.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND s.scope='GROUP'

SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(l.id::text,jsonb_build_object('enabled',l.enabled, 'automatic',l.assignment_mode='AUTO','configured',l.style_mode!='UNCONFIGURED', 'definition',CASE WHEN l.style_mode='CUSTOM' THEN s.definition END)),'{}'::jsonb)::text FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l LEFT JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_style s ON s.layer_id=l.id AND s.is_default WHERE l.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY'

SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(f.id::text,s.definition),'{}'::jsonb)::text FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature f JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l ON l.id=f.layer_id AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_style s ON s.feature_id=f.id AND s.scope='FEATURE' WHERE l.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND f.deleted=0 AND f.id IN #{id}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_style s JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature f ON f.id=s.feature_id AND f.deleted=0 JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l ON l.id=f.layer_id AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' WHERE s.scope='FEATURE' AND l.data_set_id=#{dataSetId})

SELECT l.geometry_type FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature f JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l ON l.id=f.layer_id AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' WHERE l.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND f.id=#{featureId} AND f.deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_style(id,scope,group_id,feature_id,name,definition) VALUES(#{id},#{scope}, CASE WHEN #{scope}='GROUP' THEN #{targetId} ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{scope}='FEATURE' THEN #{targetId} ELSE NULL END, 'cartography',CAST(#{definition} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (group_idfeature_id) DO UPDATE SET definition=EXCLUDED.definition,version=gis_vector_style.version+1,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_style WHERE feature_id=#{featureId} AND scope='FEATURE'
mapper.select: WITH eligible_layers AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT l.id,l.geometry_type,l.assignment_mode,g.id AS group_id,g.group_key,p.value AS rule FROM jsonb_array_elements(CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->'groups') p(value) JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_group g ON g.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND g.group_key=p.value->>'groupKey' JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l ON l.data_set_id=g.data_set_id AND l.group_id=g.id AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' WHERE #{z} >= (p.value->>'minZoom')::integer ), shapes AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT f.id,f.layer_id,l.group_id,l.group_key,l.geometry_type, jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('fclass',CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(f.properties->'fclass') IN ('string','number','boolean') THEN f.properties->'fclass' END,'code',CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(f.properties->'code') IN ('string','number','boolean') THEN f.properties->'code' END,'id',CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(f.properties->'id') IN ('string','number','boolean') THEN f.properties->'id' END,'name',CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(f.properties->'name') IN ('string','number','boolean') THEN f.properties->'name' END,'ref',CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(f.properties->'ref') IN ('string','number','boolean') THEN f.properties->'ref' END)) AS properties, to_jsonb(array_remove(ARRAY[CASE WHEN f.properties->'fclass'='null'::jsonb THEN 'fclass' END,CASE WHEN f.properties->'code'='null'::jsonb THEN 'code' END,CASE WHEN f.properties->'id'='null'::jsonb THEN 'id' END,CASE WHEN f.properties->'name'='null'::jsonb THEN 'name' END,CASE WHEN f.properties->'ref'='null'::jsonb THEN 'ref' END],NULL))::text AS null_fields, CASE WHEN COALESCE((l.rule->>'preserveBoundary')::boolean,false) OR l.geometry_type='POINT' OR #{z}=18 THEN f.display_geom WHEN l.geometry_type='LINE' THEN ST_Simplify(f.display_geom, 40075016.68557849/(power(2.0,#{z})*512)*(CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'simplifyPixels')::double precision) ELSE ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(f.display_geom, 40075016.68557849/(power(2.0,#{z})*512)*(CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'simplifyPixels')::double precision) END AS shape, CASE WHEN l.geometry_type='POLYGON' THEN ST_PointOnSurface(f.display_geom) END AS anchor FROM eligible_layers l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature f ON f.layer_id=l.id AND f.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.value FROM jsonb_array_elements(l.rule->'overrides') WITH ORDINALITY r(value,seq) WHERE jsonb_array_length(l.rule->'overrides')>0 AND l.assignment_mode='AUTO' AND ocean_gis.vector_filter_matches(f.properties,r.value->'filter',true) ORDER BY seq LIMIT 1 ) r ON true WHERE #{z} >= COALESCE((r.value->>'minZoom')::integer,(l.rule->>'minZoom')::integer) AND f.display_geom && ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y},margin => 256.0/8192) AND (COALESCE((l.rule->>'preserveBoundary')::boolean,false) OR #{z}=18 OR CASE l.geometry_type WHEN 'POLYGON' THEN ST_Area(f.display_geom)/power(40075016.68557849/(power(2.0,#{z})*512),2) >= (CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'polygonMinAreaPixels')::double precision WHEN 'LINE' THEN ST_Length(f.display_geom)/(40075016.68557849/(power(2.0,#{z})*512)) >= (CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'lineMinLengthPixels')::double precision ELSE true END) ), representations AS ( SELECT id,layer_id,properties,null_fields,group_id,group_key, CASE geometry_type WHEN 'POLYGON' THEN 'FILL' ELSE 'GEOMETRY' END AS role, geometry_type AS category,shape AS display_geom FROM shapes UNION ALL -- 从真实面提取边界，再做瓦片裁剪，避免产生裁切边缘线。 SELECT id,layer_id,properties,null_fields,group_id,group_key,'OUTLINE','LINE',ST_Boundary(shape) FROM shapes WHERE geometry_type='POLYGON' UNION ALL SELECT id,layer_id,properties,null_fields,group_id,group_key,'LABEL','POINT',anchor FROM shapes WHERE geometry_type='POLYGON' AND ST_X(anchor)>=ST_XMin(ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y})) AND ST_X(anchor)<ST_XMax(ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y})) AND ST_Y(anchor)>ST_YMin(ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y})) AND ST_Y(anchor)<=ST_YMax(ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y})) ), encoded AS ( SELECT o.id::text || ':' || o.role AS "_vector_representation_id", o.id::text AS "_vector_feature_id",o.layer_id::text AS "_vector_layer_id", o.group_id::text AS "_vector_group_id",o.group_key AS "_vector_group_key", o.role AS "_vector_render_role",o.category AS "_vector_category", o.properties,o.null_fields AS "_vector_null_fields",g.geom FROM representations o CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom(o.display_geom,ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y}),8192,256,true) AS geom OFFSET 0 ) g WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(g.geom) AND ST_Dimension(g.geom)=CASE o.category WHEN 'POINT' THEN 0 WHEN 'LINE' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ), tile AS ( SELECT COALESCE(ST_AsMVT(encoded,'features',8192,'geom' ORDER BY "_vector_representation_id"),''::bytea) AS body FROM encoded ) SELECT CASE WHEN octet_length(body)<=#{maxBytes} THEN body END AS body,octet_length(body)::bigint AS byte_size FROM tile
